'''Hazmat suit''', also known as a '''bio-hazard suit''' or '''hazmat gear''' was a form of protective clothing used to protect individuals from [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] or [[Biohazard|hazardous]] materials or environments.

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Junior Representative/Legends|Representative]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]] wore [[Color/Legends|yellow]] hazmat suits during the hunt for [[Trade Federation laboratory/Legends|Nuvo Vindi's laboratory]] on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="Blue Shadow Virus">{{TCW|Blue Shadow Virus (episode)}}</ref> Amidala and Binks later used them again when some of Vindi's airborne variant of the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]] was let into the lab, but during the effort to destroy the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] attempting to escape the facility, Amidala was infected after her suit was compromised.<ref name="MoaTM">{{TCW|Mystery of a Thousand Moons}}</ref> [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Nuvo Vindi/Legends|Vindi]] himself used a variant of hazmat gear comprised of an airtight glass hood, which he donned so that he could breathe as he attempted to flee his infected laboratory.
